summary: To run the default execution environment on remote execution nodes (not needed on Azure), create a pull secret with oc create secret generic ee-pull-secret using username, password and url registry.redhat.io, then set ee_pull_credentials_secret: ee-pull-secret in the automation controller spec.
questions: How do remote execution nodes pull the default execution environment on OpenShift?
How do I create ee-pull-secret for automation controller?

answer_card.title: Pull secret for remote execution nodes
answer_card.answer_md:
```
oc create secret generic ee-pull-secret \
  --from-literal=username=<username> \
  --from-literal=password=<password> \
  --from-literal=url=registry.redhat.io
```

Then `oc edit automationcontrollers <controller>` and set:

```yaml
spec:
  ee_pull_credentials_secret: ee-pull-secret
```

Not needed for AAP on Microsoft Azure.
